The lighting is bright with soft shadows.

The rear end of the top-left cucumber segment seems to merge slightly into the background shadow without a clear terminating edge, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity or melting.
The elliptical shape of the cut face is slightly inconsistent with the angle of the side view, suggesting a minor perspective warp common in AI generation.
